Pivot Setter.js

Hello

It's a tiny tool script ( for ~/Library/Application Support/Cheetah3D/scripts/Tool folder to install ) to set or get pivot point numerically for selected object.

http://www.tres-graficos.jp/blog/files/article.php?id=79

## #2 — AarbronBeast — 2012-02-02
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/7938/post-67186>

Set Pivot to Selected Point - C3D Script

Hi all.

Cheetah3D newbie here.  I dove into trying out some C3D scripting today and produced the following script as a companion to Hitoro's above script.  Hope you guys find it useful.  If not for its function, then maybe for it's value as a programming example.  :smile: 

It is a script that sets the pivot of a polygon object to the currently selected point on that object.

Enjoy!
